_noteW: W ADJUDICATION 2026-08-21 (loop 500) - Azir was the ONLY champion in the whole 173-file corpus with an open tier-A sweep finding, and the only reason it stayed open is that this file had no notes at all, so nothing recorded the decision. SubsequentDamageMod = [25,25,25,25,25,25,25] is the live wiki rule (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Azir, fetched 2026-08-21): Subsequent Sand Soldier attacks against the same target deal 25% damage without applying on-hit and on-attack effects. NOT CURATED, and it cannot be expressed by the existing schema: rampDataValue computes calc x (1 + steps x DataValue), an ADDITIVE bonus, while this is a REPLACEMENT - a subsequent strike deals 25% OF normal, not 125%. The units differ too: Aatrox QRampBonus is stored as the fraction 0.25 while this is stored as the whole number 25, so reusing the field would compute 26x. Nor is the trigger a repeated CAST: casting W only spawns a soldier, and whether two soldiers strike one target inside the window is positional - the same player-dependent class as Briars terrain collision and Annies Tibbers aura, both deliberately uncurated. HONEST CAVEAT, which is the part worth writing down: the engine emits one full-damage hit per W node, so a combo built with several soldier strikes on one target OVERSTATES, by 75% of a soldier for each strike after the first. The single-soldier default is correct and conservative; multi-soldier sequences are not.
